A '''Naval sword''',<ref name="Promotion" /> also known as a '''ceremonial sword''',<ref name="Fact File">{{FactFile|31|VEE 1-2|General Maximilian Veers}}</ref> was a ceremonial [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Promotion" /> Between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[9 BBY/Legends|9 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The [[insurrection on Culroon III]] as portrayed in "[[The Promotion of Lieutenant Veers]]" takes place following the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which took place in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' states that, following the insurrection, [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] [[Reproduction/Legends|had]] a [[Parent/Legends|son]], [[Zevulon Veers]], and that Zevulon was a teenager in the [[Standard month/Legends|months]] following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. Therefore, Zevulon must have been born by [[9 BBY/Legends|9 BBY]] at the latest, meaning that the insurrection on [[Culroon III/Legends|Culroon III]] must have taken place prior to or during that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> the Imperial [[General/Legends|General]] [[Irrv]] was in charge of the Imperial occupation of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Culroon III/Legends|Culroon III]] and planned a ceremony to arrange the transition to Imperial control with the planet's leader, the [[Culroon]] [[Kloff]].<ref name="Promotion" /> The ceremony would involve the exchange of the Naval [[Sword/Legends|sword]] and a ceremonial [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] to symbolize the peaceful transition of power.<ref name="Fact File" />

When the ceremony was held, it was attended by Irrv and his [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] along with Kloff and a handful of Culroon warriors, with thousands more secretly hiding in the surrounding [[Forest/Legends|forests]], who were ready to [[Insurrection on Culroon III|attack]] the Imperials. When Irrv handed Kloff the Naval sword, the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] calmly used it to impale [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jeffers]], Irrv's [[Aide/Legends|aide]],<ref name="Promotion" /> [[Death/Legends|killing]] him.<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|II|153|Jeffers}}</ref> At that signal, the warriors revealed themselves and surrounded the Imperials, who were ultimately saved through the actions of [[Junior Lieutenant/Legends|Junior Lieutenant]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]].<ref name="Promotion" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Naval sword first appeared in the short story "[[The Promotion of Lieutenant Veers]]," published in [[1987]] in [[West End Games]]'s ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'' written by [[Bill Slavicsek]] and [[Curtis Smith]].<ref name="Promotion" /> It was described as a ceremonial sword in the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 31|thirty-first issue]] of ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'', a magazine published by [[De Agostini]],<ref name="Fact File" /> written by [[Iain Lowson]],<ref name="FF Author">{{LinkedIn|url=in/iainlowson|text=Iain Lowson|archivefile=File:IainLowson-LinkedIn.png}}</ref> and released on [[July 31]], [[2002]].<ref name="FFDate">{{FFdates|31}}</ref> In "The Promotion of Lieutenant Veers," Irrv hands the Naval sword to Kloff as part of the ceremony,<ref name="Promotion" /> which was contradicted by ''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' as it stated that Kloff would give the sword to Irrv in exchange for a ceremonial blaster.<ref name="Fact File" /> The contradiction was repeated in the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 14|fourteenth issue]] of the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File (2014)|revised run]] of ''The Official Star Wars Fact File'',<ref name="Fact File 14">{{FactFile2014|14|VEE 1-4|General Maximilian Veers}}</ref> which was published on [[April 9]], [[2014]].<ref name="Fact File 14 Date">{{FactFile2014Dates|14}}</ref> This article follows the short story's version of events.
